svg.title: AI AI Captain subscription budget key, Fjord
svg.desc: A 72 by 72 key for each AI subscription: Claude, OpenAI, GitHub Copilot, and JetBrains AI. Bars show the percent used of each limit window, with an 80 percent mark. Bands show LIMIT and paid extras.

g.text: AI AI CAPTAIN / SUBSCRIPTION BUDGET KEY / FJORD
One key for each subscription. It shows how much of the plan is used and when it resets. Drawn at 1.5× scale with the runtime renderer.
Same family as the info key: canvas background, 80% mark, warning color from 80%. The border and a state band show LOW, LIMIT, and paid extras. Dashed + ?: not reported.

g.text: Product mark of the subscription owner, not of the harness. Plan name on the right.
5H = 5-hour window, WK = weekly window, MO = monthly or 30-day credits. Mark at 80%.
Normal color below 80%. Warning color from 80%. Error color at 100%.
Reset time of the window that is nearest to its limit, and its percent used.
Normal border below 80%. Warning border from 80% or when paid extras are in use.
Error band with a warning triangle. The reset time moves to the top row.
Warning band EXTRA or TOP-UP. The top row shows extra spend or credits left.
Dashed border and bars, “?” for the plan and the percent. After a reset, a window starts at 0%.
Next to session keys at 72 px

The hub keeps only numbers, plan names, and reset times (ARCH-08). Pressing a budget key opens the usage page of the provider.
Brand marks: Lobe Icons 1.100.0. Interface symbols: Lucide 0.468.0. Illustrated plans do not imply that usage data is available for every account.
